hazards.control: Pressure test before opening to the well; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Seal assembly and polished bore
function: The stack of seals on the tubing that lands in the packer bore and seals while allowing tubing movement.

tabs.overview: Seal units on a mandrel stab into the packer or a polished bore receptacle; the length of the bore allows the tubing to expand and contract without unseating.
tabs.engineering: Seal material for the fluids and temperature; stroke length per the thermal calculation.
tabs.safety: A leaking seal shows as annulus pressure.
tabs.evidence: API 6A scope for trees (S1), API Spec 14A for safety valves (S29), API 11D1 for packers (S21), field practice (S9). Photographs read for proportion only.
